mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 declines for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment above 1% signals labor market tightening, which raises wage pressures and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth exceeds 1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth > 1% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 declines for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO declines for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and a sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) jointly signal weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
